title: t27c on fifo.t27 -- a pointer mutation the tests cannot see
desc: head_ptr + 1 to + 3 in one sed: every test still passes, because the suite asserts fill counts and flags, never pointer values -- the exact hole a torn multi-bit pointer would slip through; git restores the spec.
commands: sed -i '' 's/(state.head_ptr + 1) % cfg.depth/(state.head_ptr + 3) % cfg.depth/' specs/fpga/fifo.t27 && git diff -U0 specs/fpga/fifo.t27 | tail -n 2
